description: Allowlisted engineering skills for Claude Code and Codex (amillez plugin pack). Upstream packs install via npx skills; amillez skills live under skills/.

core.description: Always installed: amillez-mode (required working mode), grill-me with grilling, and the amillez orchestration, verification, model setup, TypeScript, correct, blast-radius, reflect, show-me-your-work, and figure-it-out skills

mobile.description: React Native, Expo, and native (Argent, Emil, Expo, SWM, Uniwind, Margelo Nitro modules, simfleet). Not installed with --groups core alone.

upstream.note: All Argent skills. Bump this ref and the one in scripts/install.sh together with the @swmansion/argent CLI.

upstream.when: Reviewing / critiquing animation and motion (Emil craft bar)
upstream.note: Upstream sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own. Launch prompts name it for critique passes.
Upstream grill-me is a shim that calls the Skill tool with "grilling". Install both, or /grill-me fails with "Unknown skill: grilling".

upstream.when: Writing, reviewing, or debugging any React Native or Expo code
Building or debugging Uniwind className styling in RN

upstream.note: Margelo Nitro modules skills (same mobile category as other native RN skills). Pack also ships react-native-vision-camera-realtime; not on the allowlist yet.

amillez.when: Required working mode for every coding agent (single agent or Orca worker); adapted from pstack poteto-mode (MIT, see skills/amillez-mode/UPSTREAM.md)

Size gate, then Orca with an Opus 5.5 xHigh coordinator for large work; worker brief template, retry by failure mode; every worker runs amillez-mode (brief template and retry rules adapted from pstack, MIT, see skills/orchestrate-agents/UPSTREAM.md)

Generate a project-local verify-<app> skill (Launch, Doctor, Drive, Evidence, Cleanup, an agent-friendly app CLI for dev setup, seeding, test users, reset, and opening a feature, plus a feature map); amillez-mode overlay
Audit and keep a project verify-<app> skill, its feature map, and its app CLI honest
Pick the session's model lane from the policy and install or update the user-level Claude Code and Codex model rules (templates/models.md)

Reading, writing, or reviewing any .ts or .tsx file; TypeScript grounding of amillez-mode type-system and boundary principles (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/typescript-best-practices/UPSTREAM.md)
/correct: find the mistakes agents repeat in a repo and make each one impossible; the procedure lives in the skill (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/correct/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own and /correct loads it. amillez-mode's repeated-correction trigger names it.

amillez.when: /blast-radius: find what a change could break beyond the diff and prove the one fact it is safe because of by running real code; the procedure lives in the skill (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/blast-radius/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own and /blast-radius loads it. amillez-mode's untrusted-diff trigger names it.

amillez.when: /reflect: three reviewers on different model lanes mine a finished Claude Code or Codex session log, and a synthesizer routes the learnings to concrete skill or ai-eng-practices edits as one small PR or a garden hand-off; the procedure lives in the skill (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/reflect/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own and /reflect loads it. amillez-mode's reflect trigger names it.

amillez.when: /show-me-your-work: keep a reviewable TSV decision trail for long, autonomous, or multi-phase work, audit it against this run's session log, and get a cross-model review before handing back; the format lives in the skill (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/show-me-your-work/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own and /show-me-your-work loads it. amillez-mode's long-work trigger and its playbooks name it.

amillez.when: /figure-it-out: design and run a bespoke, auditable workflow when no narrower playbook fits or one agent owns a long migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work reviewed after stepping away; parallel workers go to Orca instead; the procedure lives in the skill (ported from pstack, MIT, see skills/figure-it-out/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Sets disable-model-invocation: true, so the model never invokes it on its own and /figure-it-out loads it. amillez-mode's no-fitting-playbook and size-gate triggers name it.

amillez.when: Boot, slim, restore, claim, and shut down simulators and emulators through simfleet, and run worktree lanes with leased Metro ports; Argent still drives proof (ported from entropyconquers/simfleet, MIT, see skills/simfleet/UPSTREAM.md)
amillez.note: Needs the simfleet CLI and its host tools (see README). Bump the pin in skills/simfleet/UPSTREAM.md with the CLI version. Keep MOBILE_AMILLEZ_SKILLS in scripts/install.sh in sync.
